strongest_objection: The map's claim to be a map rather than a list rests on the five relations named in form_inference, and two of the five are not carried by their edges as written. The loop Known only by staking it -> Asking the gatekeeper -> Known only by staking it is asserted, but the label never says how a settlement is an ask of a gatekeeper (it is: the settlement tells every party holding the option to challenge that the holder pays not to know, and they reprice that option), and it ends with 'only a judgment won ends the loop', which has the validity asymmetry backwards: a validity judgment binds only the challenger who lost and the next one arrives with new art, while an invalidity judgment ends the patent everywhere, so the loop ends only in the answer the holder feared. The item text has that asymmetry right and its own edge contradicts it. The incompatibility between Self-inquiry widens the warranty and Blindness priced as knowledge is stated with inverted polarity: form_inference says a seller 'cannot both learn without knowing and be excused for not looking' and then that under actual knowledge 'both stand', which is the same case described twice with opposite results; the real incompatibility is between the warranty's escape (the knowledge group) and Blindness's mechanism (imputation), which are never both live under one definition of knowledge. A third edge, Use that burns the source -> Hard pull, states the condition for running a cover inverted, describing the case where the covert channel was never needed. All three are label repairs that leave the items untouched and the forms survive them, which is why this is admit-with-repairs and not return. Beyond the edges I tried to break the type with a buyer's deal momentum and a peek that spends alpha, and the closest pair I could find, the well-testing seller under a disclosure statute against the same seller under a knowledge-qualified rep, and the type held; the items are mechanisms, the strange members (a question that commits the ear, a cover question, a required depth of inquiry) are kept strange, and the residue rejections in the ledger are real.

items.item: Hard pull: the inquiry is logged where strangers read it, so the peek is priced by every party that was not asked; as the mortgage rate a borrower can learn only by applying, where the application is a hard inquiry on the credit file that every later lender sees as a search and that lowers the score it is read against, so a borrower who shops five lenders one after another arrives at the fifth as someone who has been turned down four times whether or not she was; the inquiry is the application; the commitment is a record of having asked, borne by the asker and read by parties who were never asked; the less committing inquiry is the soft pull or prequalification, which answers with an estimate rather than a rate and exists because the hard one committed, and the bureaus' rate-shopping window, in which pulls within a set span count as one, is the institution that makes the serial question askable; not lead-time-floors' Seeking is telling, where the source sees the search for its replacement, since here the readers are strangers to the source and read the count of asks rather than the fact of one.
items.why: Satisfies of: the ask itself is the record, the escape is a softer form supplied by the same institution. One fact wrong: the rate-shopping window that counts several pulls as one is a rule of the scoring models (FICO, VantageScore), not of the bureaus, and the near-horizon test names who publishes it, so the party must be right.
items.repair: Hard pull: the inquiry is logged where strangers read it, so the peek is priced by every party that was not asked; as the mortgage rate a borrower can learn only by applying, where the application is a hard inquiry on the credit file that every later lender sees as a search and that lowers the score it is read against, so a borrower who shops five lenders one after another arrives at the fifth as someone who has been turned down four times whether or not she was; the inquiry is the application; the commitment is a record of having asked, borne by the asker and read by parties who were never asked; the less committing inquiry is the soft pull or prequalification, which answers with an estimate rather than a rate and exists because the hard one committed, and the scoring models' rate-shopping window, in which pulls within a set span count as one, is the institution that makes the serial question askable; not lead-time-floors' Seeking is telling, where the source sees the search for its replacement, since here the readers are strangers to the source and read the count of asks rather than the fact of one.

items.item: Asking the gatekeeper: the question is put to the party who holds the option, so the asking tells the holder that the option is wanted and the holder reprices it before answering; as the founder who asks her existing investor whether the fund would bridge and learns nothing about the bridge she did not already know but tells the fund the round is not coming, so the bridge, if offered, arrives with terms written for a company that needs it, or the tenant who asks the landlord what breaking the lease would cost and is thereafter a tenant who is leaving, or the buyer whose request for a quote in a thin market tells the one dealer that size is coming; the inquiry is the direct ask; the commitment is the holder's updated price, borne by the asker, and it is created by the asking whether or not the answer is yes; the less committing inquiry is one made through a party with no stake, the lawyer who reads the lease for its break clause, the counsel who knows what bridges that fund has done, the question asked about a third company; not Hard pull, where the record of the ask is read by strangers, since here the only reader is the one who holds the answer and the price moves in a single hand; adds to investor-tells' Borrowed eyes the mirror case, the founder's ask read by the investor.
items.why: Satisfies of: disclosure of need to the holder reprices the option before the answer. Three carriers (bridge, lease break, thin-market quote) share the mechanism and the escape (an asker with no stake). Kept as written.

items.item: Ruling you can't unask: the authority whose reading of a rule is sought answers on the record, so an adverse answer closes the ambiguity the asker was living in; as the taxpayer who requests a private letter ruling on a structure and, refused, can no longer file it as an honest reading, since the reading was sought and given in writing to this taxpayer and the file now exists, or the exporter who asks customs for a binding classification and is told the higher tariff line and cannot afterward ship under the lower one as a good-faith mistake; the inquiry is the request for the ruling; the commitment is the loss of good-faith ambiguity and the authority's file, borne by the asker; the less committing inquiry is the no-names meeting, in which counsel describes a hypothetical client, and the informal call whose answer binds nobody, each of which carries less weight for the same reason it commits less; not Confidant with a duty, where the asked party's own obligation is triggered by the question, since here the asked party is free and it is the answer that binds; and not Asking the gatekeeper, where the holder reprices what the asker wants, since the authority sells nothing and the price of asking is paid in the asker's later defences.
items.why: Satisfies of: the request commits the asker to be bound by whichever answer comes, so the good-faith reading is lost the moment the adverse ruling exists. The no-names meeting is the real practice and carries less weight for the reason given. Kept.

items.item: Confidant with a duty: whom the question is put to decides what the asking commits, because the asked party's own duties are triggered by hearing it; as the founder who asks a board member whether she should take the acquisition offer and has thereby informed a director, who may be bound to bring the offer to the full board, or the controller who asks the auditor whether a booking was right and has put it in the audit file, or the patient who asks whether a bruise could have been from a parent and has crossed a mandated reporter's threshold; the inquiry is the same question in a different ear; the commitment is the ear's duty, borne by the asker as a process now running that the asker cannot stop; the less committing inquiry is the ear whose duty runs back to the asker, the lawyer under privilege, the physician under confidentiality, the priest under the seal, which is why counsel is retained before the question is asked and not after; not Asking the gatekeeper, where the asked party holds the option and reprices it, since here the asked party holds nothing the asker wants and is committed by the question against its own preference.
items.why: Satisfies of and is the map's best member: the escape is a person, not a form. The mandated-reporter case as written has any patient crossing the threshold; the duty is triggered by suspected abuse of a child or dependent adult, so the case needs the patient to be a child. Repaired to a child asking a school nurse; nothing else touched.
items.repair: Confidant with a duty: whom the question is put to decides what the asking commits, because the asked party's own duties are triggered by hearing it; as the founder who asks a board member whether she should take the acquisition offer and has thereby informed a director, who may be bound to bring the offer to the full board, or the controller who asks the auditor whether a booking was right and has put it in the audit file, or the child who asks the school nurse whether a bruise could have been from a parent and has crossed a mandated reporter's threshold; the inquiry is the same question in a different ear; the commitment is the ear's duty, borne by the asker as a process now running that the asker cannot stop; the less committing inquiry is the ear whose duty runs back to the asker, the lawyer under privilege, the physician under confidentiality, the priest under the seal, which is why counsel is retained before the question is asked and not after; not Asking the gatekeeper, where the asked party holds the option and reprices it, since here the asked party holds nothing the asker wants and is committed by the question against its own preference.

items.item: Self-inquiry widens the warranty: a party that investigates itself expands what it warrants, because its promises are qualified by what it knows; as the seller whose representations are given 'to the seller's knowledge' and who commissions vendor due diligence before the sale, so that every defect the diligence finds is now a defect the seller knows and warrants against, while the defect it never looked for stays outside the promise; the inquiry is the seller's own diligence; the commitment is the widened warranty, borne by the seller at the indemnity claim; the less committing inquiry is the knowledge group, since the contract defines the seller's knowledge as the actual knowledge of named individuals, and a seller who keeps those individuals out of the diligence sessions can learn and not know, an escape bounded by the buyer's insistence that the group include the people who would know and by any clause that adds what they should have known; not Knowing obliges, where a duty attaches to the finding, since here no duty attaches and what widens is the promise's coverage; and not Tainted by looking, which walls the looker from the thing, since here the wall runs inside one party between those who looked and those who sign.
items.why: Satisfies of: after vendor diligence the seller can no longer give the knowledge-qualified rep clean, though silence remains a choice. The knowledge group is real and its two bounds (buyer's insistence on the group's membership, a should-have-known clause) are exactly right. Kept; it is one end of my neighbor test.

items.item: Tainted by looking: seeing the thing forecloses building it independently, because the look can never afterward be unproven; as the acquirer whose engineers read the target's code in diligence and who, if the deal fails, cannot build a rival module without facing the claim that they copied, so the look removed the build option that existed before it; the inquiry is the technical diligence; the commitment is contamination, borne by the looker in every later dispute, and created the moment the look occurs, before any answer is drawn from it; the less committing inquiry is the clean room, a separate team that never looks and is shown only a specification, or the third-party auditor who examines the code and reports pass or fail without content, each of which answers a narrower question so that the wide one stays askable; the residuals clause, which licenses what the looker's engineers happen to remember, is the negotiated price of looking without a room; not deal-deaths' Paid in the tasting, where the look supplies enough of the good that the deal is not needed, since here the look removes the looker's own alternative.
items.why: Satisfies of, and the text says the type's own sentence: contamination is created at the look, before any answer is drawn. Clean room, pass/fail auditor, residuals clause are all real. Kept. Note for a later breath: the analyst who calls the company and is told something material, and thereafter cannot trade the stock she was researching until it is public, is this item's finance case with the law as carrier and the wall and restricted list as the room; it adds nothing to the mechanism but would widen the register.

items.item: Breaking to know: the inquiry consumes the object it was to decide about, so the answer arrives for a thing that is gone and the decision moves to its siblings; as the weld sectioned to learn its penetration, the lot of cartridges proof-fired to learn its pressure, the bottle opened to learn whether the vintage has kept, so what is learned is about the batch and the choice 'use this one' is spent by the asking; the inquiry is the destructive test; the commitment is the loss of the specimen and the inference from sibling to sibling, borne by whoever must now trust that the untested ones are alike; the less committing inquiry is the non-destructive one, ultrasound or radiography for the weld, a proof load below failure for the beam, which answers about this object and worse, and consumes a little of it anyway, since a proof load spends fatigue life; not witness-architectures' Half kept back, which reserves a duplicate so the reading's error leaves a trace, since here the concern is not the record of the reading but that the thing decided about is what the reading destroyed.
items.why: Satisfies of: the specimen is gone, so 'use this one' is spent and the inference moves to siblings. The proof-load remark that a non-destructive test consumes a little anyway is a real and useful qualification. Kept.

items.item: Question plants itself: asking a party what it would do installs in that party a decision it was not facing, so the answer describes a party the question has changed; as the manager who asks the engineer whether she is thinking of leaving, and converts an unexamined staying into a staying that has now been chosen or not, or the spouse who asks whether the other would stay if the money ran out; the inquiry is the direct question to the subject; the commitment is that the subject now holds the option as an option, borne by the asker, who cannot again have the subject who had not thought of it; the less committing inquiry is to ask the class rather than the person, the anonymous engagement survey, or to watch rather than ask, calendar gaps and recruiter mail, each of which answers about a population or a posture and not about her; not Asking the gatekeeper, where the asked party prices something the asker wants, since here nothing is priced and what changes is which futures the asked party can see; speculative as a mechanism, since the lodging of the option in the asked party is inferred from what askers report and not measured.
items.why: Marked speculative and kept speculative, but as written it strains of, which asks what the finder can then choose: the commitment names a state the asker cannot recover (the unexamined subject) rather than a choice removed. The choice removed is retention by inertia: after the question, keeping her is a decision she is also making. Repaired to name that lost choice and to keep the recoverability clause; the speculative marker stands.
items.repair: Question plants itself: asking a party what it would do installs in that party a decision it was not facing, so the answer describes a party the question has changed; as the manager who asks the engineer whether she is thinking of leaving, and converts an unexamined staying into a staying that has now been chosen or not, or the spouse who asks whether the other would stay if the money ran out; the inquiry is the direct question to the subject; the commitment is that the subject now holds the option as an option, borne by the asker, who has lost the choice of keeping her by inertia and must now keep her by a decision she is also making, and who cannot again have the subject who had not thought of it; the less committing inquiry is to ask the class rather than the person, the anonymous engagement survey, or to watch rather than ask, calendar gaps and recruiter mail, each of which answers about a population or a posture and not about her; not Asking the gatekeeper, where the asked party prices something the asker wants, since here nothing is priced and what changes is which futures the asked party can see; speculative as a mechanism, since the lodging of the option in the asked party is inferred from what askers report and not measured.

items.item: Bear hug that puts them in play: the question changes the asked party's obligations and the asker's retreat at once, because some parties cannot receive a question without a process; as the acquirer who writes to a public target's board proposing to buy it at a price, so that the board, which could have declined a private call with a shrug, must now consider the proposal under its duties, may have to disclose it, and, once it decides to sell, may be obliged to seek the best price rather than this one, while the acquirer, once the letter is known, cannot withdraw without being read as having found something or been refused; the inquiry is the written offer; the commitment is the process the board must run and the asker's loss of an unwatched exit, borne by both; the less committing inquiry is the private, non-binding indication of interest, which triggers no process and which the target's counsel reads for whether it is really private; not first-mover-forecloses' Initiate the test case that shapes the governing precedent, an attack on the responder's options, since here the asker wanted an answer and got a process; not Question plants itself, where what lodges in the asked party is a thought, since here what lodges is a duty; the duties named are a simplified reading of one jurisdiction's public-company law.
items.why: Satisfies of on both sides: the asker's loss of an unwatched exit is a finder's choice removed, and the board's process is the commitment lodged in the asked party. The duties are hedged correctly (must consider, may disclose, may owe best price once it decides to sell). Kept.

items.item: Answer only inside the incision: the answer of the grade needed exists only in a state that itself demands a decision, so the deciding must happen on a provisional answer within a window the inquiry opened; as the surgeon who sends a frozen section from the operating table and gets a preliminary read while the patient is open, so that resect or close must be chosen in the anesthesia window on the fast read, since the permanent pathology arrives in days and the patient cannot be held open for it; the inquiry is the intraoperative sample; the commitment is the decision made in the window on the lesser answer, borne by the patient, and the window is made by the inquiry itself; the less committing inquiry is the preoperative biopsy, which answers earlier and worse, and which in some tumours carries its own commitment through seeding along the needle track, so the earlier question is not free; not Breaking to know, where the specimen is consumed and the decision moves to its siblings, since here the patient is whole and the decision is moved into the window.
items.why: Satisfies of, but the inquiry is misnamed: the frozen section does not make the anesthesia window, the opening does, and the section is sent from inside it; as written the sample is charged with a commitment the operation created. Also 'earlier and worse' mis-describes the preoperative biopsy: its permanent sections are per slide more reliable than a frozen read, and what it answers is less (the lesion's nature, not the margin or the node, which become questions only once the specimen is out). Repaired on both points.
items.repair: Answer only inside the incision: the answer of the grade needed exists only in a state that itself demands a decision, so the deciding must happen on a provisional answer within a window the inquiry opened; as the surgeon who sends a frozen section from the operating table and gets a preliminary read while the patient is open, so that resect or close must be chosen in the anesthesia window on the fast read, since the permanent pathology arrives in days and the patient cannot be held open for it; the inquiry is the opening itself, with the sample sent from inside it, since the sample alone makes no window; the commitment is the decision made in the window on the lesser answer, borne by the patient, and the window is made by the inquiry itself; the less committing inquiry is the preoperative biopsy, which answers earlier and about less, since the margin and the node become questions only once the specimen is out, and which in some tumours carries its own commitment through seeding along the needle track, so the earlier question is not free; not Breaking to know, where the specimen is consumed and the decision moves to its siblings, since here the patient is whole and the decision is moved into the window.

items.item: Fuse shorter than the finding: the inquiry takes longer than the option lives, so finding out first is a way of letting the option expire; as the buyer whose structural survey needs three weeks against an offer that must be accepted by Friday, the employer whose reference checks outlast the candidate's competing offer, the investor whose diligence outlasts the expiry a rival wrote on its term sheet; the inquiry is any that needs the calendar; the commitment is the option's death during the finding, borne by the finder, who learns the answer to a question that no longer has a choice attached; the less committing inquiry is the purchased interval, the option fee, the earnest money at risk, the exclusivity bought with a break fee, the inspection period written into the contract, so that 'find out first' is available at a price and the price is the market's measure of what the finding commits; not lead-time-floors' No-shop, where the counterparty's paper serialises the search, since here nothing forbids the parallel and the calendar alone closes it; not runway-illusions' Runway in shots, which counts the trials a runway holds, since here the runway is the option's and not the finder's.
items.why: The weakest fit to of, since the inquiry's content changes nothing and only its duration kills the option; the boundary claim owns this and states the reason it is in (the inquiry is what does the expiring). The purchased interval as the market's price for 'find out first' is the item's real contribution. Kept.

items.item: Pilot that grandfathers itself: a trial run to find out whether a thing works becomes the default while it runs, so the answer arrives to a party for whom stopping is now a change; as the contractor brought in to see how it goes who after a year is the person the team cannot lose, the pilot with a customer whose integration is built during the pilot so that not renewing is a churn, the prototype that ships because it works, the trial separation that installs two households; the inquiry is the trial; the commitment is the moved status quo, borne by whoever must now act to end what began as a look; the less committing inquiry is the trial with its end fixed at the start, a date, a decision rule written before the data, a pilot built on plumbing meant to be thrown away, and each of these is faked often enough that a counterparty reads whether the end is real; not deal-deaths' Ghost closing, where a deal is lived before it is signed and loses its urgency, since there the parties wanted the deal and here they wanted to know; adds to risk-rebound-effects' The hardened patch the case where the thing that ossified was an experiment.
items.why: Satisfies of: the moved status quo is a choice relocated, and the escape (a stop fixed before the data) is priced by whether stops have been honoured before, which the edge to Only the real thing answers uses. Kept.

items.item: Knowing obliges: a duty attaches to the finding, so the learner who finds cannot afterward choose to have not found; as the manufacturer whose engineers test a fielded part and find a failure mode, and who now must recall or notify rather than decide whether to, the seller who tests the well and must disclose the result to every buyer, the radiologist who orders the scan for one thing and must report the nodule found for another; the inquiry is the test; the commitment is the duty, borne by the learner, and it is created by the answer's existence rather than its use; the less committing inquiry is the unrecorded reading, the consultant asked to say it aloud and not write it, the sample kept off the books, each of which is a hazard of its own since the law often treats the oral finding as known; not deal-deaths' Report that must be acted on, where the written record obliges the buyer's lender or board, since here the duty is the finder's own and needs no third party to read it.
items.why: Satisfies of: the duty is created by the answer's existence, not its use, and the escape (an unrecorded reading) is named as a hazard rather than a trick. Kept; it is the other end of my neighbor test.

items.item: Finding starts the fuse: the finding starts a clock the learner did not choose, so the choice the answer bears on begins to expire from the moment it is known or should have been; as the owner who discovers the foundation crack and thereby starts the limitations period against the builder, the insured whose claims-made policy requires notice as soon as practicable after the insured knows, the company whose determination that a breach is material starts the days it has to file; the inquiry is any that finds; the commitment is the fuse, borne by the learner, who now has a dated period in which 'decide afterward' must occur; the less committing inquiry does not exist by design, since the discovery rule runs from when a reasonable party would have discovered, so not looking does not stop the clock, only hides its reading; not runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, a permission that expires on a date no cash extends, since here the date is set by the finding and not by the calendar; and not Knowing obliges, where the finding removes a choice, since here it dates one.
items.why: Satisfies of: the finding dates a choice the finder still holds, and the discovery rule is what makes the escape absent by design. Kept, but moved; see seriation. The SEC materiality case is really Knowing obliges with a clock attached (the filing is compelled, not merely dated), which is a small leak between the two items and not worth a cut.

items.item: Use that burns the source: the answer can be used only in ways that do not reveal how it was obtained, so a class of actions is removed from the learner at the moment of learning; as the reader of an adversary's ciphers who cannot act on every decrypt without telling the adversary the cipher is read, and so must let some convoys sail, or the bidder who learns a seller's reserve from a leak and cannot bid exactly at it without exposing the leak; the inquiry is the covert channel; the commitment is that every act on the answer must be plausibly sourced elsewhere, borne by the learner as a constraint on all later moves; the less committing inquiry is made afterward and is a second question whose only purpose is to be the visible source of the first's answer, the reconnaissance flight sent to 'find' the convoy already located, the case rebuilt in the open from a tip, so the covert inquiry costs a second, overt one; not Asking the gatekeeper, where the asking discloses need, since here the asking discloses nothing and the using does; the cipher case is the documented Second World War practice of protecting decrypts, simplified.
items.why: Satisfies of: a class of acts is removed at the moment of learning. The escape is honestly named as a second commitment rather than a lesser one, and the cipher case makes no Coventry-style claim. Kept; its edge needs repair, not the item.

items.item: Known only by staking it: the answer can be had only by putting at risk the thing whose value the answer decides, so the inquiry is a wager on the asset; as the patent whose validity is known only by asserting it, since assertion invites the invalidity challenge that, lost, ends the patent everywhere, so a weak patent is worth most unasserted and its holder cannot learn its strength without spending it, or the form contract whose enforceability is known only by suing on it, where a loss binds every copy in the book; the inquiry is the assertion; the commitment is the asset staked, borne by the holder, and the answer, if adverse, is the asset's end; the less committing inquiry is the settlement before judgment, which buys the question back at a price and with a record that tells the next challenger the holder feared the answer, and the private opinion of counsel, which answers only the holder; not first-mover-forecloses' Initiate the test case that shapes the governing precedent, the attacker's move, since here the holder wants to know and the knowing costs the thing; adds to deal-deaths' Price found too precisely the case where what is found too precisely is the asset's own strength.
items.why: Satisfies of: the assertion is the wager. 'A loss binds every copy in the book' for the form contract is simplification (preclusion against the drafter and precedent, not privity), acceptable under the declared mode. Kept; the loop edge from it needs repair.

items.item: Only the real thing answers: the answer is defined as the act's outcome, so any inquiry short of the act answers a neighbouring question and the act cannot be tried; as the device whose yield is known by detonation, which spends the device and the treaty, the backup whose restorability is known by restoring, the evacuation plan known by evacuating, the ally known to come by the war; the inquiry is the act; the commitment is total and coincides with the answer, borne by whoever the act commits; the less committing inquiry is the proxy, the simulation, the tabletop, the subcritical test, the restore to a spare machine, each of which answers about the model and not the thing, and the distance between them is where the surprise lives; not Pilot that grandfathers itself, where the trial becomes the thing by running, since here the trial was the thing from the first; and not Breaking to know, which spends a specimen to learn about its siblings, since here there are no siblings and the thing learned about is the thing spent.
items.why: Satisfies of as the limit case: the commitment coincides with the answer. The 'distance between model and thing is where the surprise lives' is the operator-grade line the register asked for. Kept.

items.item: Blindness priced as knowledge: the question not asked is charged as if answered, so the escape of not finding out commits as the finding would; as the purchaser who can claim the innocent-landowner defence to a contamination liability only by having made all appropriate inquiries before buying, so that not inspecting is not innocence but the loss of the defence, the buyer under caveat emptor who could have inspected and cannot later rescind, the officer whose deliberate avoidance of a fact is treated by the court as knowledge of it; the inquiry is the one refused; the commitment is imputed knowledge, borne by the refuser, with none of knowledge's uses; the less committing inquiry is the inquiry of exactly the required depth and no deeper, the site assessment that satisfies the standard without the sampling that would find the thing, and the law sets that depth for the purpose; not Knowing obliges, where the finding creates the duty, since here the not-finding does; not Finding starts the fuse, which dates a choice from when the finder should have looked, since here the whole defence is lost and no clock is offered; the doctrines named are simplified from one jurisdiction's environmental and criminal law.
items.why: The map's discovery member and worth keeping strange. Note the type tension: the of sentence's head clause says 'the act of finding something out', and here the inquiry is the one refused; the of sentence's tail (sorted by where the escape lives, 'nowhere at all, because the question not asked is charged') admits it, and the exploration records the changed question. Kept as is; the head clause should not be softened to fit, since the brief's distinguishing question ('is find out first, decide afterward available') is answered no here from both sides.

neighbor_test.left: Self-inquiry widens the warranty: a party that investigates itself expands what it warrants, because its promises are qualified by what it knows; as the seller whose representations are given 'to the seller's knowledge' and who commissions vendor due diligence before the sale, so that every defect the diligence finds is now a defect the seller knows and warrants against, while the defect it never looked for stays outside the promise; the inquiry is the seller's own diligence; the commitment is the widened warranty, borne by the seller at the indemnity claim; the less committing inquiry is the knowledge group, since the contract defines the seller's knowledge as the actual knowledge of named individuals, and a seller who keeps those individuals out of the diligence sessions can learn and not know, an escape bounded by the buyer's insistence that the group include the people who would know and by any clause that adds what they should have known; not Knowing obliges, where a duty attaches to the finding, since here no duty attaches and what widens is the promise's coverage; and not Tainted by looking, which walls the looker from the thing, since here the wall runs inside one party between those who looked and those who sign.
neighbor_test.right: Knowing obliges: a duty attaches to the finding, so the learner who finds cannot afterward choose to have not found; as the manufacturer whose engineers test a fielded part and find a failure mode, and who now must recall or notify rather than decide whether to, the seller who tests the well and must disclose the result to every buyer, the radiologist who orders the scan for one thing and must report the nodule found for another; the inquiry is the test; the commitment is the duty, borne by the learner, and it is created by the answer's existence rather than its use; the less committing inquiry is the unrecorded reading, the consultant asked to say it aloud and not write it, the sample kept off the books, each of which is a hazard of its own since the law often treats the oral finding as known; not deal-deaths' Report that must be acted on, where the written record obliges the buyer's lender or board, since here the duty is the finder's own and needs no third party to read it.
neighbor_test.separating_case: One seller, one well, one test that finds arsenic. Under a statute that requires a seller to disclose known material defects, the finding is Knowing obliges: silence is no longer a choice, the buyer need have asked for nothing, and the escape is to leave the result unwritten, which the statute treats as known anyway. Under no such statute, selling on a contract whose reps are given to the seller's knowledge, the same finding is Self-inquiry widens the warranty: silence remains a lawful choice, what is gone is the clean knowledge-qualified rep, and the escape is that the test was run by someone outside the named knowledge group. The separating test is whether, after the finding, the seller may still lawfully say nothing: where it may not, the carrier is the law and the item is Knowing obliges; where it may but can no longer promise, the carrier is the contract and the item is Self-inquiry widens the warranty. They collapse only where the contract charges the seller with what it should have known and the buyer drafts the disclosure schedule as a rep, which is the antecedent of the map's own edge from Self-inquiry to Blindness priced as knowledge, so the collapse is already on the map as a condition rather than a confusion.

boundary_case: The acquirer whose diligence has cost so much that walking has become unthinkable is the tempting nonmember and is out: unthinkable is not unavailable, the choice set is buy or walk exactly as before, and what moved is the buyer's own accounting, which is the sunk-cost cousin of the boundary claim's diligence fee. Its cousin that is in: the break fee the buyer owes the seller if it walks after the exclusivity it bought to do the diligence, which is Fuse shorter than the finding's purchased interval, a price paid for 'find out first' that a third party now holds. The fence holds: an inquiry is in when it removes, dates, prices, relocates, or imputes a choice, and out when it only makes one feel expensive.

seriation.note: The axis (where the less committing inquiry lives) is an honest itinerary and the endpoints are right: it opens where the escape is supplied by the institution that made the question committing and closes where the escape of not asking is itself charged. One reorder is argued. Finding starts the fuse sits fourteenth with an escape the note calls 'nothing', and the walk then returns to three live escapes (a cover question, a settlement, a proxy) before reaching Blindness priced as knowledge, whose escape is also nothing and charged. The note itself says the two are 'the same doctrine seen from two ends, constructive discovery', and then separates them by four places, which conceals the kinship it names. Move Finding starts the fuse to immediately before Blindness priced as knowledge, so the tail reads: Knowing obliges (an unwritten reading) -> Use that burns the source (a second question written afterward) -> Known only by staking it (a settlement) -> Only the real thing answers (a proxy) -> Finding starts the fuse (nowhere, since the clock runs from when the finder should have looked) -> Blindness priced as knowledge (nowhere, and charged). The adjacency lost, Knowing obliges -> Finding starts the fuse, is replaced by Knowing obliges -> Use that burns the source, from an unwritten reading to a second written one, which also teaches; and the walk no longer visits nowhere and comes back. The of sentence's sorted list should follow the reorder. Every other adjacency the note defends (gatekeeper -> ruling -> confidant; warranty -> clean room as the hinge; incision -> fuse -> pilot as the three escapes in time) holds and the middle hinge, that a counsel who has built a knowledge group already knows how to build a clean room, is the seriation's best line.

edges.why: A real conditional: the antecedent (the gatekeeper keeps a record other gatekeepers read) fails for a private landlord and holds for a lender, and the consequent moves the escape from an intermediary to a softer form, which the walk's first step needs. The lunch-table example is gossip rather than a record and drifts toward lead-time-floors' Seeking is telling, but the bureau example carries the label.

The label's conditional is right, but the form_inference reads it as an incompatibility with the polarity inverted: it says a seller 'cannot both learn without knowing and be excused for not looking in one jurisdiction, while where only actual knowledge counts both stand', and under actual knowledge the seller can do both. The true incompatibility is between the warranty's escape and Blindness's mechanism: wherever the knowledge group stands, not looking is not charged, and wherever not looking is charged, the group is closed. The label should say this so the form claim is carried by the edge and not by the note.
edges.repair_label: If the law or the contract charges the seller with what its people should have known, the knowledge group that lets a seller learn without knowing is closed, since the individuals kept out of the room are charged with what the room found, and Blindness priced as knowledge runs in the same clause; where knowledge is defined as the actual knowledge of named persons and nothing is imputed, the knowledge group stands and not looking is not charged; so the escape from the warranty and the charge for not looking are never both live under one definition of knowledge, and a seller offered the one should expect to be spared the other.

edges.why: A real conditional whose antecedent fails in the lawyer's ear and holds in the director's, and it is the passage between levels the form claims: a personal question becomes a finding in a body the asker does not control. Kept.

The dependency is real (a covert answer costs a second, overt commitment), but the label's condition is inverted: it says the cover is worth running only where the overt question, asked cold, would have cost less than the answer is worth, and in that case the covert channel was never needed. The cover pays because the covert answer aims the overt inquiry so that it succeeds cheaply, where asked cold it would have cost more or found nothing (a hundred flights for one convoy). The form_inference repeats the inverted condition.
edges.repair_label: If the covert answer is to be acted on, a second inquiry must be run in the open to stand as its source, and that second inquiry is itself a Hard pull or an ask of the gatekeeper, so the learner pays two commitments for one answer; the cover is worth running only where the overt question, aimed by the covert answer, costs less than the answer is worth, which is so precisely because the same question asked cold would have cost more or found nothing; where the overt question was cheap cold, the covert channel was never needed.

edges.why: The form_inference calls this the map's loop, but the label never says why its target is Asking the gatekeeper: it does not name whose option is repriced or by what ask. The settlement is an ask put to the class of challengers, who hold the option to challenge and reprice it on learning the holder pays not to know; that is the gatekeeper mechanism with the challenger as holder, and the next assertion closes the loop. The label also has the validity asymmetry backwards: 'only a judgment won ends the loop' is false, since a validity judgment binds only the losing challenger and the next one arrives with new art, while an invalidity judgment ends the patent everywhere; so the loop ends only in the answer the holder feared. The item text already has this asymmetry right; the label contradicts it.
edges.repair_label: If the holder settles the test case to keep the answer unknown, the settlement is an ask put to every party holding the option to challenge, and the challengers reprice that option on learning the holder pays not to know, which is Asking the gatekeeper with the challenger as the holder; so the question bought back is asked again at a higher price by a party who now knows to ask, and the loop closes back on Known only by staking it; a judgment won does not end it, since validity is settled only against the party who lost and the next challenger arrives with new art, while a judgment lost ends the asset everywhere, so the loop ends only in the answer the holder feared or in a patent nobody finds worth challenging.

edges.why: A real conditional: the antecedent (the trial runs past the point where stopping is a change) fails where a stop has been honoured before, and the consequent is the passage the form claims, from a proxy to the act by running. Kept.

edges.from_handle: Bear hug that puts them in play
edges.why: A real conditional and the map's cleanest operator inference: the lowest committing form of the ask commits the asked party's mind and none of its duties, which is the actual choice. The label states the lodging ('a board with a number in mind') as certain though it inherits Question plants itself's speculative modality; the priorities entry carries the test (merger proxies), so kept with that note.

modality_problems: Confidant with a duty: the mandated-reporter case as written has any patient crossing the threshold; the duty is triggered by suspected abuse of a child or dependent adult, so the patient must be a child. Repaired.

Answer only inside the incision: the frozen section does not create the anesthesia window, the opening does; and 'earlier and worse' mis-describes the preoperative biopsy, whose permanent sections are per slide more reliable than a frozen read and which answers about less, not worse. Repaired.

Known only by staking it -> Asking the gatekeeper: 'only a judgment won ends the loop' reverses the validity asymmetry; a validity judgment binds only the party who lost, an invalidity judgment ends the patent everywhere. Repaired in the label; the item already had it right.

Hard pull: the rate-shopping window that counts several pulls as one belongs to the scoring models (FICO, VantageScore), not the bureaus; repaired because the near-horizon test names who publishes it.
Use that burns the source -> Hard pull: the label's condition for when the cover is worth running was inverted (it described the case where the covert channel was never needed). Repaired.

Bear hug -> Question plants itself: the label asserts the lodged question as fact while the target item is marked speculative; not repaired, since the priorities entry carries a real test, but the edge inherits the speculative modality and a reader should know it.

Finding starts the fuse: the SEC materiality case is a compelled filing with a clock, which is Knowing obliges with a fuse attached rather than a dated choice; a small leak between two items, not worth a cut.
best_unresolved_seed: The interim look that spends alpha. A trial sponsor who looks at accumulating data before the end is charged for the look: each interim analysis spends part of the significance level, so the final answer must clear a stricter bar than it would have if nobody had looked, and the sponsor who peeks has made success harder to declare before any answer is used. It is in type and absent, and it lives in two places on the walk at once: the escape is a chosen ear whose duty runs to the trial rather than to the asker (the independent data monitoring committee sees, the sponsor stays blind), which is Confidant with a duty inverted, and the stop fixed before the trial (a pre-specified alpha-spending function and stopping rule) is Pilot that grandfathers itself's escape made rigorous. It would also give the map its first member where the charge for looking is a number set by arithmetic rather than by a court or a counterparty, which tests whether the type's fence ('prices a choice') can hold a price that no one bears as money.
independent_review_line: Fable critic: admitted after repairing the three edges the form inference leaned on (the settlement loop now names the challenger as the repriced gatekeeper and has the validity asymmetry the right way round, the warranty/blindness incompatibility is stated between the one's escape and the other's mechanism, and the cover-question condition is un-inverted), repairing four items for modality and for naming the finder's lost choice, and moving Finding starts the fuse beside Blindness priced as knowledge so the walk reaches nowhere once.
